facts.fact: Communications and ICT Minister Angellah Kairuki said on 18 July 2026 that Tanzania is building a National AI Data Centre, to hold the country's data onshore so Tanzanian and African researchers can train AI systems on it using hydro and geothermal power.
facts.system: Kituo cha Taifa cha Data za Akili Unde (National AI Data Centre)

facts.fact: The Minister said the Tanzania Development Vision 2050, launched the previous year, describes JAMII AI, a Kiswahili large language model.

systems.system: Kituo cha Taifa cha Data za Akili Unde (National AI Data Centre)
systems.owner: Government of Tanzania (Ministry of Communications and Information Technology)
